verdict.rationale: Authenticator's own Cloud Backup lets users back up their accounts and restore them by signing in on a new device. However, it depends on a Microsoft personal account (and iCloud on iOS), and the evidence does not show that every token transfers in a single guided step. missing for 10: evidence that all account types (e.g., work/school) restore without re-registration, documentation of a single guided migration flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of successful phone-to-phone transfer.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: back up information on all the accounts you have in Authenticator so that if you lose your mobile or get a new device, you can sign in to restore previously saved accounts
Turn on the Cloud Backup toggle. Select a Microsoft personal account where the backup will be stored.
To back up your accounts on an iOS device you need to enable iCloud to use Authenticator and then enable backup in Authenticator.
